source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every healthy person's readings must average exactly 37.0 °C.

intelligence.enrichment: The normal temperature of a healthy human body is taken as 37.0 °C, but it is an average of many healthy people, so a healthy person may have a normal temperature slightly higher or lower than 37.0 °C. Because 37.0 °C is an average value, small differences around it can still be normal for a healthy person. The learner correctly applies this rule: The normal temperature of a healthy human body is taken as 37.0 °C, but it is an average of many healthy people, so a healthy person may have a normal temperature slightly higher or lower than 37.0 °C. Every healthy person must have exactly 37.0 °C; any other body-temperature reading means illness.
